_readme: GPU/RAM memory profiles for sharing the GPU between ComfyUI and Ollama (the History tagger). The app reads the GPU's total VRAM (nvidia-smi, or ComfyUI /system_stats) and always picks the profile with the highest minVramMB that is <= total VRAM (Auto). There is no manual override. Edits here are picked up without a restart. All sizes are MiB.

profiles.label: Under 12 GB VRAM (e.g. RTX 2080 Ti 11 GB)

workflowVramNeedMB._readme: Free VRAM a ComfyUI job wants when it is queued, per preset id or 'ai:<id>' (AI Workflow presets; default = the preset's own vram.estMB). 2080 Ti measurement: Flux.2 klein 1 MP peaks ~6.8-7.5 GB total once loaded. On the 'if-needed' profile Ollama is unloaded only when free VRAM minus headroomMB is below this. ComfyUI itself offloads its own models to RAM when VRAM is short.
